verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a first-party guide for bulk launching workflows through its REST API, and an export-job API for pulling data out. That is genuine bulk capability, but it is evidenced only for workflow launches and exports, each in a single line. Missing for 10: bulk update or edit across many records or contracts, details of the bulk launch mechanics and limits (batch size, error handling), a bulk UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
